meta.title: Kyber — Ukulawula yonke imishini ngesikhathi sangempela
meta.description: I-Kyber iyingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela yokulawula imishini. Ukusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni ngo-8 ms. Amarobhothi, amadrowuni, izimoto, amadeskithophu akude nemihlaba egxilisayo. Yakhiwe yithimba le-VLC.

nav.solutionsLead: I-SDK eyodwa. Imihlaba eyisithupha lapho ibanga kufanele linyamalale khona.

home.lead: I-Kyber iyingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela yokulawula imishini. Amarobhothi, amadrowuni, izimoto. Amadeskithophu akude. Imihlaba egxilisayo. Kwehla kufike ku-8 ms kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele.
home.manifesto: Ku-200 ms, uyabukela. Ku-8 ms, uyalawula. Izingcingo zevidiyo zakhelwa izingxoxo, hhayi ukulawula. Amadeskithophu akude akhelwa i-imeyili, hhayi imishini. Uma irobhothi lokuhlinza libambezeleka ngo-200 ms, ukusika kwenzeka lapho ubukade ukhona — hhayi lapho ukhona manje.
home.playLead: Hudula noma unyakazise isikhombi sakho kule ndawo. Ichashazi elikhanyayo nguwe. Indandatho ngumshini owamukela inhloso yakho ngenethiwekhi.
home.playHint: Nyakazisa isikhombi noma umunwe wakho lapha
home.lat1d: Ikhesa inamathele esandleni sakho. Irobhothi linyakaza njengoba nawe unyakaza.
home.lat2d: Ukubambezeleka okuzwakalayo. Kwenzelwe ukubambezeleka okungaguquki, hhayi ukubambezeleka okuphansi.
home.lat3d: Ubuka lokho osanda kukwenza. Kulungele i-imeyili. Kuyingozi ekuhlinzeni.
home.lat4d: Ukubambezeleka okweqile. Akusebenziseki kunoma yini edinga ukusebenzisana.
home.statsLead: I-Kyber ivumelanisa ividiyo, umsindo, okokufaka kokulawula nedatha yethelemetri newashi elilodwa, ngokubambezeleka okungaphansi kwamamilisekhondi ayi-10.
home.f1d: 8–10 ms kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni. Kushesha ukwedlula ukusebenzisana kweso nesandla somuntu.
home.f2d: Ividiyo, umsindo, izinzwa nokulawula — konke emugqeni wesikhathi ofanayo.
home.f3d: Kubethelwe ngokuphelele ku-QUIC/HTTP3. Ichweba elilodwa, lidlula kunoma yiluphi udonga lokuvikela.
home.f6d: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, Quest, Vision Pro.
home.solLead: I-SDK efanayo ye-Kyber inika amandla amarobhothi okuhlinza namadeskithophu akude, amaqembu amadrowuni nezifakwa-ekhanda ze-XR. Isebenza noma kuphi lapho ibanga kufanele linyamalale khona.
home.pipeTitle: Kusuka enhlosweni kuya esenzweni ngokuphazima kweso.
home.pipeLead: Azikho izindawo zokulinda phakathi kwezinyathelo. Lapho nje isigaba esisodwa siphela, i-Kyber idlulisela kwesilandelayo.
home.vlcTitle: Saxazulula ividiyo ezigidigidini zabantu. Manje sixazulula ukulawula.
home.vlcLead: Iminyaka engamashumi amabili yengqalasizinda yevidiyo. I-VLC isemadivayisini ayizigidigidi. Iminikelo ejulile ku-FFmpeg. Abantu abafanayo abaxazulula ukudlalwa kwevidiyo manje baxazulula ukulawulwa kwemishini ngesikhathi sangempela.
home.vlcStat3: ms kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni nge-Kyber
home.ossLead: Umgogodla we-Kyber ungowomthombo ovulekile ngaphansi kwe-AGPL v3. Wufunde, wenze igatsha lakho, uwusebenzise emkhiqizweni wakho — bese uxhumana nathi uma udinga okwengeziwe.
home.tlTitle: Iminyaka engamashumi amabili nanhlanu sinyakazisa amaphikseli. Manje sinyakazisa imishini.
home.t2001: I-VideoLAN yaba ngumthombo ovulekile ngaphansi kwe-GNU GPL e-École Centrale Paris.
home.t2003: U-Jean-Baptiste Kempf ujoyina iphrojekthi ye-VLC esengumfundi.
home.t2006: U-JB uthatha ubuholi, ahlele kabusha ithimba nekhodi.
home.t2008: I-VideoLAN iba yinhlangano ezimele engenzi nzuzo.
home.t2009: I-VLC yeqa abasebenzisi abayizigidi eziyi-100 emhlabeni wonke.
home.t2012: Kusungulwa i-Videolabs ukwakha imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezisekelwe ku-VLC.
home.t2024: I-Kyber iqala njengephrojekthi eseceleni yokusakaza ngesikhathi sangempela.
home.t2025: Inkampani i-Kyber isungulwa e-Paris. I-VLC ifinyelela ekulandweni okuyizigidigidi eziyi-6.
home.t2026a: I-Kyber iphumela obala ngemali yokuqala engu-$5M eholwa yi-Lightspeed.
home.t2026b: I-VLC yeqa ukulandwa okuyizigidigidi eziyi-7. I-Kyber 0.28 iletha imishini esingathayo ye-macOS (ekuhlolweni kokuqala).
home.vlcAlso: I-VideoLAN iphinde yethulela umhlaba i-x264, i-dav1d kanye nesisekelo esivulekile se-DVD ne-Blu-ray.
home.playNote: Izilungiselelo ezenziwe ngaphambili ziyisibonelo sokubambezeleka okwengezwa kokufakayo kwakho — akuzona izilinganiso zokusebenza.
home.pipeKyber: I-Kyber kusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, ezimweni ezifanele kakhulu
home.pipeFits: Ku-120 Hz ifreyimu eyodwa ithatha u-8.3 ms. Lonke uchungechunge lwe-Kyber — kusukela ekuthwebuleni kuya ekuboniseni — lwakhelwe ukungena ngaphakathi kwayo.
home.t2020: I-Kyber iqala njengephrojekthi eseceleni ngesikhathi u-JB eyi-CTO e-Shadow, inkampani yemidlalo esakazwa emafini.
home.t2022: I-Kyber 0.1.0: umsingathi neklayenti le-Windows ne-Linux ngoxhumano olulodwa lwe-QUIC olubethelwe.
home.ossRepoLead: I-Kyber ihlukaniswe yaba izinqolobane ezigxile emisebenzini ethile — umongo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, okuncikile nokusebenza. Ikakhulukazi i-Rust, kanye ne-VLC ne-FFmpeg.
home.rk_kyber: Lapho ungaqala khona, imibhalo namanothi okukhishwa
home.rk_kyctl: Indawo yokulawula: ukusetha iseshini, ukuqinisekisa ubunikazi, ukuhlela
home.rk_kymux: Indawo yedatha: yonke ibhayithi, ihlanganiswe phezu kwe-QUIC
home.rk_kynput: Ukuthwebula nokudlulisela okufakwayo: ikhibhodi, igundane, izilawuli zemidlalo, ibhodi lokunamathisela
home.rk_kymedia: Ukuthwebula, ukubhala ngekhodi, ukuhumusha ikhodi nokubonisa
home.proof1d: Kwezokuvikela, ezokuxhumana ngocingo, amarobhothi nobuhlakani bokwenziwa.
home.proof2d: Kufika ku-€3.7M kusuka ku-France 2030 ukuze kusakazwe izithombe zezokwelapha ze-3D ezigxilisayo kusuka kumandla okubala akude.
home.proof3d: Izinsuku ezine zemiboniso ebukhoma esitendini se-Scaleway, kanye nenkulumo ne-Inria.
home.proof4d: $5M ne-OVNI Capital ne-Kima Ventures. Ithimba labantu abangu-26 ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa.

cta.devTitle: Umthombo ovulekile. Ilayisensi ye-AGPL. Hlanganisa emavikini ambalwa.
cta.entTitle: Amalayisensi ezohwebo, ukusekelwa okuzinikele nokufakwa okwenzelwe wena.

remote-desktop.name: Ideskithophu Ekude
remote-desktop.card: Thatha indawo yesixazululo esidala ngento onjiniyela nabasebenzisi bakho abangeke bakhalaze ngayo.
remote-desktop.lead: Ideskithophu ekude enamandla kunoma yimuphi umshini. Imbobo eyodwa. Ihambisana nezivikelo zenethiwekhi. Ukusabela, ikhwalithi yesithombe nokulawula kwedeskithophu yasendaweni — noma ngabe ukuphi.
remote-desktop.capTitle: Ukufinyelela kude sekungumlando. Ukulawula kude sekufikile.
remote-desktop.c1d: Konke ukusakaza kuhambisana newashi elinembe ngaphansi kwemilisekhondi eyishumi, ngakho umshini wakho okude uphendula njengekhompyutha esedeskini lakho.
remote-desktop.c2d: Ukusakaza okusezingeni eliphezulu nokubambezeleka okuphansi, okuqina kumanethiwekhi ezinkampani angazinzile nomthamo oguquguqukayo.
remote-desktop.c3d: Imbobo eyodwa ebethelwe edlula kunoma yisiphi isivikelo senethiwekhi senkampani. Akukho ukuzihlupha nge-VPN. Akukho ukulungiselelwa kwenethiwekhi okuntekenteke.
remote-desktop.b1d: Izinga lamafreyimu elingaguquki lomsebenzi we-3D, wevidiyo, we-CAD nowezithombe eziyinkimbinkimbi.
remote-desktop.b2d: Okufakwayo kufika cishe ngaso leso sikhathi kusuka kudivayisi kuya esikrinini.
remote-desktop.b3d: I-macOS, i-Windows ne-Linux nhlangothi zombili. Awuboshelwa kusistimu eyodwa.
remote-desktop.b4d: Idlula ezivikelweni zenethiwekhi zezinkampani ngembobo eyodwa.
remote-desktop.u1d: Ukufinyelela okugcwele, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yikhwalithi, emishinini ye-GPU ye-3D, yevidiyo ne-CAD.
remote-desktop.u2d: Imishini ekude enamandla, usebenzisa okuhlelwe kalula endaweni.
remote-desktop.u3d: Veza kuphela okudingekayo. Indawo encane yokuhlaselwa.
remote-desktop.u4d: Enye indlela elula nesheshayo esikhundleni sezinhlelo ze-VDI ezindala.
remote-desktop.u5d: Finyelela amasistimu abucayi ngaphandle kokudalula idatha noma ingqalasizinda.
remote-desktop.u6d: Uvivinyo lokugcina lokubambezeleka. Uma kuqina lapha, kuqina noma kuphi.
remote-desktop.x1d: Amaseshini azivumelanisa nezinguquko zomthamo nokubambezeleka esikhundleni sokuma noma ukunqamuka.
remote-desktop.x2d: Xhuma usuka emishinini eminingana, noma kuphi. Ideskithophu efanayo, ukusebenza okufanayo.

xr.name: Okuhlangenwe nakho okucwilisayo
xr.lead: Ukunyakaza, okufakwayo, umsindo nokubonwayo kuhamba njengento eyodwa. Ukucwila kuyaphazamiseka lapho nje kuvela ukubambezeleka — i-Kyber igcina umjikelezo uphelele, ngisho noma ukwakhiwa kwezithombe kwenzeka efwini.
xr.c1d: Uma yonke imizwa ilandela iwashi elilodwa, umuzwa wokungahambisani uyanyamalala. Imihlaba ebonakalayo izwakala iqinile njengokwangempela.
xr.c2d: Isivinini esifanele ukulawula sigcina ukunyakaza kwakho nesikrini kuhambisana ku-Quest naku-Vision Pro.
xr.c3d: Dlulisela ukwakhiwa kwezithombe efwini ukuze ukusatshalaliswa kwe-Unreal ne-Unity kuhlale kuthembekile kunoma iyiphi inethiwekhi.
xr.b1d: Ukwakhiwa kwezithombe kwenzeka kude; ukusebenzisana kuzwakala sengathi kusedivayisini.
xr.b2d: Sakaza i-XR edinga amandla amakhulu usuka ekhompyutheni emaphakathi, ngaphandle kwama-GPU asemaphethelweni.
xr.b3d: I-Unity, i-Unreal, i-D3D11, i-Vulkan nokusakaza kwamaphikseli. Akudingeki ubhale kabusha.
xr.b4d: I-Quest, i-Vision Pro, ideskithophu newebhu kusuka engqalasizindeni eyodwa.
xr.u1d: Amandla ekhompyutha amaphakathi nokusebenzisana kwesikhathi sangempela.
xr.u2d: Izikhala ezinkulu ezibonakalayo ngaphandle kwemikhawulo ye-GPU yasendaweni.
xr.u3d: Isiqondiso sendawo esisabela ngokushesha endaweni yomsebenzi.
xr.u6d: Izindawo ze-3D ezihlanganyelwayo ezizwakala zihlanganyelwe ngempela.
xr.x1d: Ukulandelela ikhanda, izilawuli, izinzwa nezinto ezixhunywayo kuhlala kuxhumene ngokuqinile nokwakhiwa kwezithombe.
xr.x2d: Umsindo, ividiyo, ukulandelela nokufakwayo kumugqa wesikhathi owodwa — akukho ukungavumelani okuzwakalayo.
xr.x3d: Ukuxhumana kwenethiwekhi okulula, ukusabalalisa okuphephile nokulethwa ngewebhu.

robotics.name: Amarobhothi
robotics.lead: Isendlalelo sengqalasizinda phakathi kwenhloso yomuntu nesenzo somshini. Ukuqeqesha, ukuqapha nokuthatha izintambo komuntu ngokushesha kumarobhothi kunoma yiliphi izinga.
robotics.c1d: Imininingwane yokuqeqesha engcono kakhulu ivela ngalowo mzuzu lapho umuntu elungisa iphutha. Iwashi elilodwa lisho ukuthi imodeli yakho ifunda emininingwaneni ehambisanayo nengonakalanga.
robotics.c2d: Umsebenzisi oyedwa angagada amarobhothi angamashumi amaningi — uma nje ingqalasizinda ishesha ngokwanele.
robotics.c3d: Uma ukuzisebenzela kwehluleka, umuntu uthatha izintambo ngesikhathi esithathwa ukubona inkinga. Hhayi ngemuva kwama-200 ms.
robotics.b1d: Ukusebenzisana kwakho kuthatha u-30–50 ms. I-Kyber ithatha ngaphansi kwama-10 ms.
robotics.b2d: Amakhamera, amamakrofoni, izinzwa zamandla nezendawo kumugqa wesikhathi owodwa. Akukho ukuchezuka.
robotics.b3d: Isithombe esifiphele ngesikhathi sangempela singcono kunesithombe esiphelele esephuze ngemizuzwana emibili.
robotics.b4d: ROS, Linux, Windows. Amarobhothi afana nabantu, izingalo zamarobhothi, amasistimu okuhlinza, amaqembu amarobhothi.
robotics.useTitle: Kusukela kumarobhothi afana nabantu kuya ezingalweni zezimboni.
robotics.u1d: Ukuqeqeshwa nokuvikeleka kwamarobhothi angena emakhaya nasezindaweni zokusebenza.
robotics.u2d: Uma ukubambezeleka kusongela impilo, i-ms ngayinye iyabaluleka.
robotics.u3d: Ukulawula ukude ngaphandle kokufaka abantu engozini.
robotics.u4d: Ukuqapha amaqembu amarobhothi nokuthatha izintambo ngokushesha ezimeni ezingajwayelekile.
robotics.u5d: Ukuhlola nokulungisa kude kakhulu negumbi lokulawula.
robotics.u6d: Amaqoqo emininingwane ahlanzekile okulawula ukude obuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela.

drones.name: Amadrowuni
drones.card: I-IP ephelele, ayinqunyelwe umsakazo. Isebenza nge-Starlink.
drones.lead: Uma ukuzisebenzela kwehluleka, asikho isikhathi sokubambezeleka kwama-200 ms. I-Kyber iletha ukulawula kwezinga le-BVLOS nge-IP, ukuze abasebenzisi bathathe izintambo ngokushesha.
drones.c1d: Yonke imisakazo ihambisana ndawonye, ukuze lokho umshayeli akubonayo nalokho idrowuni ekwenzayo kube yinto eyodwa.
drones.c2d: Ukuthatha izintambo ngaphansi kwama-10 ms kuvumela abashayeli basabele ezithiyweni sengathi bagibele kuyo.
drones.c3d: Ukulungiswa kwamaphutha kusengaphambili kugcina imiyalo isabela ngisho nalapho inethiwekhi ingazinzile.
drones.b1d: Ukulawula okuphelele ukude nokuqonda isimo bukhoma.
drones.b2d: Uhlelo olulodwa. Izinkundla eziningi zamadrowuni. Ukusebenzisana okungenazihibe.
drones.b3d: Izingqimba ze-3D ngesikhathi sangempela nokubona okuqhutshwa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa.
drones.b4d: Izitembu zesikhathi ezihambisana ngokuphelele zokufunda nokuqinisekisa.
drones.u1d: Ukuqapha ingqalasizinda nezindawo zamandla ngesikhathi sangempela.
drones.u2d: Ukuletha okuphephile nokunembile. Noma kuphi, noma nini.
drones.u3d: Ukubona nokuxhumanisa kuzo zonke izimoto nezinkundla.
drones.u4d: Amadrowuni andizayo nawangaphansi kwamanzi okusesha nokuhlenga.

autonomous-vehicles.name: Izimoto Ezizishayelayo
autonomous-vehicles.card: Umuntu uthatha izintambo ngokushesha ezimweni ezingavamile.
autonomous-vehicles.lead: Ukuthatha izintambo ngokushesha nedatha yezinzwa evumelanisiwe. I-Kyber iqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo azisoze zaba zodwa ngempela.
autonomous-vehicles.c1d: Uma umuntu kufanele angenelele, ukudluliselwa kwezintambo kuyashelela futhi ukulawula kwenzeka ngaso leso sikhathi.
autonomous-vehicles.c2d: Yonke imisakazo ihlanganisiwe, ukuze ukubuyekezwa kwezigameko namamodeli kwakhiwe phezu kweqiniso elihambisanayo.
autonomous-vehicles.c3d: Kuvumelana nezivikeli zenethiwekhi, kufakwa ngembobo eyodwa, futhi ubona konke kulo lonke iqembu lezimoto zakho.
autonomous-vehicles.b1d: Umsebenzisi osekude uthatha imoto eyodwa ngokuphazima kweso.
autonomous-vehicles.b2d: Qapha izimoto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa ungaphuthelwa lutho.
autonomous-vehicles.b3d: Ukudlulisa okulandelanayo nokudluliselana okushelelayo phakathi kwamanethiwekhi.
autonomous-vehicles.u1d: Abasebenzisi basabela ngokushesha kunalokho iso elingakubona.
autonomous-vehicles.u2d: Ividiyo, okokufaka nedatha okuhambisanayo ukuze kubuyekezwe izigameko.
autonomous-vehicles.u4d: Usizo olusuka kude ezimweni ezingavamile ukuzishayela okungakwazi ukuzixazulula.
autonomous-vehicles.u5d: Ukushayela usekude kwamaloli, ogandaganda namabhasi amancane.
autonomous-vehicles.u6d: Konke ukungenelela kuba yidatha ehlanzekile yokuqeqesha.

ai-agents.name: Abenzeli Bobuhlakani Bokwenziwa
ai-agents.card: Ukuhlaziywa kokubonwayo kusuka efwini kuya edivayisini, ngesikhathi sangempela.
ai-agents.lead: Ubuhlakani obungabambezeleki. I-Kyber ixhuma ukucabanga kwedijithali neqiniso elibonakalayo, ivale igebe phakathi kwesinqumo semodeli nomthelela waso emhlabeni wangempela.
ai-agents.c1d: Ukuhlaziya kwefu kuhlanganiswe ngqo nemishini esendaweni, ukuze impendulo yomenzeli isheshe njengomcabango wakhe.
ai-agents.c2d: Konke okubonwayo nayo yonke imiyalo kulandela iwashi elilodwa eliyinhloko — amaqoqo edatha ahlanzekile futhi avumelanisiwe.
ai-agents.c3d: Uxhumano oluphephile nolusheshayo luvumela umuntu ukuthi athathe izintambo ngokushesha lapho izinto ziba nzima.
ai-agents.b1d: Indlela esheshayo kakhulu yokusebenzisana namamodeli nabenzeli ngesikhathi sangempela.
ai-agents.b2d: Ukusakaza okubhalwe isikhathi okuhambisana nemethadatha ukuze kube nesithombe esiphelele.
ai-agents.b3d: Ukuqapha ngokushesha nokulawula ngesandla ukuze kube nokuphepha okuphelele.
ai-agents.b4d: Amarekhodi ahambisanayo okulungisa amaphutha ngokunembile nokuqeqesha amamodeli.
ai-agents.u1d: Imijikelezo eshelelayo yokubona nokulawula yemishini ezisebenzelayo.
ai-agents.u2d: Ukuthola nokusabela ngesikhathi sangempela kwengqalasizinda ebalulekile.
ai-agents.u3d: Ubuchwepheshe bomuntu emishinini ekude, ngaphandle kokubambezeleka.
ai-agents.u6d: Imiyalo ithunyelwa emishinini ngokushesha nje uma isinqunyiwe.
ai-agents.x1d: Kuthwetshulwa kusakazwe ngaphandle kokulibaziseka kokugcina okwesikhashana, ngakho umenzeli ubona okwenzeka manje.
ai-agents.x2d: Imodeli icabanga ngokwenzeka manje, hhayi okwedlule.
ai-agents.x3d: Imiyalo ifika emishinini ngokushesha, kanti abaphathi babona konke ngaphandle kokubambezeleka.

tech.lead: Ukuthwebula ividiyo, umsindo, imiyalo yokulawula, idatha yezinzwa: konke kuvumelaniswe emugqeni wesikhathi owodwa, konke kudlula ekuxhumaneni okukodwa okubethelwe.
tech.thrTitle: Ngaphansi komkhawulo wokusabela kwesandla neso lomuntu
tech.thrLead: Ukusabela kwesandla neso lakho kuthatha u-30–50 ms. I-Kyber isebenza kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni ngaphansi kuka-10 ms, uma izimo zilungile.
tech.pushLead: Iningi lezinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela libeka izilondolozi zesikhashana phakathi kwesinyathelo ngasinye ukuze kuzinziswe inethiwekhi. Ukubambezeleka kuhlala kufana, kodwa kuphezulu. I-Kyber ithumela idatha phambili ngokushesha nje uma isilungile, ishintsha ikhwalithi, kodwa ayikwengezi ukubambezeleka.
tech.clockLead: I-Kyber ikala njalo ukuphambuka kwewashi bese ihlela kabusha konke emugqeni wesikhathi ohlanganisiwe. Iwashi elasetshenziswa bukhoma yilona elisetshenziswa nasekudlaleni kabusha. Azikho izinkinga zokuqondanisa izithombe. Akukho ukungavumelani phakathi kwalokho umshini okubonile nalokho okwenzile.
tech.connLead: Ukuthutha nge-QUIC/HTTP3, okubethelwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni ngokuzenzakalelayo. Azikho iziteshi ezihlukene ezinamawashi ahlukene nezindlela ezihlukene zokwehluleka. Akukho ukulungiselela isivikeli senethiwekhi ngezimbobo ezingama-25.
tech.prioTitle: Izinhlobo ezimbili zedatha. Amazinga amabili okubaluleka.
tech.prioLead: Usalele izithombe eziyishumi emuva? I-Kyber ikukhombisa isithombe sakamuva bese ilahla ezinye. Cindezela inkinobho, lokho kucindezela kuhlala kufika.
tech.prioMediaList: Ividiyo nomsindo · Ithelemetri nezinzwa · Imibhalo engezansi nemethadatha
tech.prioCtrlList: Igundane, ikhibhodi, isilawuli semidlalo, ukuthinta · USB, amafayela, ibhodi lokunamathisela · Amaphrothokholi angokwezifiso
tech.netLead: Amasathelayithi alahlekelwa uxhumano. Imibhoshongo iyaminyana. Hudula isilayida ukuze wehlise izinga lenethiwekhi bese ubona lokho i-Kyber ekuvikelayo.
tech.n1d: Amaphakethe alahlekile akhiwa kabusha khona lapho.
tech.n2d: Umkhawulokudonsa uyehla, ikhwalithi iyehla, kodwa ukubambezeleka akunyuki.
tech.n3d: Ukulawula kuhlala kubaluleke ngaphezu kwekhwalithi yevidiyo.
tech.secTitle: Ukuvikela ezingeni lephrothokholi. Akekho othenjwa ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa.
tech.s1t: Ukubethela kusuka komunye umkhawulo kuya komunye
tech.s1d: Kwakhelwe phezu kwe-QUIC/HTTP3. Asikwazi ukubona ithrafikhi yakho, ngisho noma idlula engqalasizindeni yethu.
tech.s2d: Izimvume ezinemininingwane: ubani oxhumayo, afinyelela kuphi, nokuthi angenzani.
tech.s3d: Ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo edijithali kokusakaza okubucayi nokuvimba izithombe-skrini lapho isistimu yokusebenza ikuvumela khona.
tech.a2d: Umsebenzisi oyedwa, iqembu lemishini. Noma ababukeli abaningi, umshini owodwa.
tech.a3d: Kusuka emaphethelweni kuya efwini kuya kumsebenzisi, kunqamula imingcele yamanethiwekhi.
tech.notLead: I-WebRTC yakhiwa eminyakeni eyishumi edlule ukuze kube nezingcingo zevidiyo phakathi kwabantu. U-100–200 ms ulungile engxoxweni, kodwa uyingozi ekulawuleni imishini. Izinkampani ezinkulu zichithe iminyaka namashumi ezigidi zakha izinhlelo zazo zokulawula ukude. I-Kyber ilethela lelo khono bonke abanye.
tech.connLegacyD: Iziteshi ezihlukene, amawashi ahlukene, izindlela ezihlukene zokwehluleka — futhi kaningi amaphothi amaningi odonga lomlilo.
tech.cmpNote: Izinhloso zokuklama njengoba zichazwa yi-Kyber — akusona isivivinyo sokuqhathanisa.
tech.scopeLead: Izilinganiso zangempela ezivela kule thebhu: isikhathi esiphakathi kwezinhlaka zokunyakaza, nokubambezeleka ngaphambi kokuba ukuchofoza kwakho nezinkinobho ozicindezelayo kusingathwe. Yile ndlela okubukeka ngayo ukukhathalela yonke imilisekhondi.
tech.scopeTry: Chofoza, thepha noma uthayiphe noma kuphi ukuze ulinganise ukubambezeleka kokufaka.
tech.fecLead: Amaphakethe amane edatha ahamba nephakethe elilodwa lokuhlola le-XOR. Lahla elilodwa, umamukeli alakhe kabusha khona lapho, ngaphandle kokuya nokubuya. Lahla amabili, ukubuyisa kuyehluleka — yingakho i-Kyber iphinde ivumelanise ikhwalithi.
tech.fecOk: Libuyiselwe khona lapho — akukho kuthumela kabusha, akukho kulinda
tech.fecFail: Kulahleke amaningi kakhulu — kudingeka ukuthumela kabusha
tech.fecModel: Isibonelo sokufundisa — akulona uhlelo lwangempela lwe-FEC lwe-Kyber

about.storyTitle: Ukulawula imishini kusabambeke ku-2010. Siyakulungisa lokho.
about.story1: Udokotela ohlinzayo eParis uqondisa ingalo yerobhothi emaphandleni aseBrittany. Isisebenzi sendawo yokugcina izimpahla eChicago sithatha izintambo zefokhlifti ebambekile. Umshayeli wedroni udinga ukuthatha izintambo ngokushesha lapho umshini ulahlekelwa ukulawula kobuhlakani bokwenziwa.
about.story2: Kuzo zonke lezi zimo, inethiwekhi iyisitha. Ngemilisekhondi ezingu-200 ubuka okusevele kwenzekile. Ngemilisekhondi ezingu-8 ulawula okwenzeka manje. Lowo umehluko phakathi kokubuka nokulawula — phakathi kokusebenza ngokuphepha nengozi. Siwuvalile.
about.teamLead: Abasunguli be-Kyber bakha i-VLC — efakwe kumadivayisi ayizigidigidi — futhi baba negalelo ku-FFmpeg, injini engemuva kwamavidiyo amaningi ku-inthanethi. Iminyaka engamashumi amabili yengqalasizinda yevidiyo, yomthombo ovulekile nolwazi olujulile lwamaphrothokholi, manje inwetshelwa emikhakheni emisha.
about.v1d: Iminyaka engamashumi amabili isifundise ukuthi izindlela ezimfishane zibiza kakhulu kunalokho ezikongayo. Yonke imilisekhondi ibalulekile.
about.v2d: Ukuvuleka kwakha ukwethembana, kunika ukuzimela futhi kwakhe imiphakathi yobuchwepheshe.
about.v3d: Odokotela abahlinzayo, abaqhubi, onjiniyela. Ubuchwepheshe buyanyamalala; amandla omuntu ayanda.
about.v4d: Siyakhipha, bese siyagubha. Sizethemba ngoba sinekhono — hhayi ngoba sisho kanjalo.
about.v5d: Siqasha abantu abakhaliphile nabanomusa. Sike sadlula ithalenta elingahambisani nathi — futhi sizophinda.
about.careersLead: Ithimba eligxile kwenye yezinkinga zekhompyutha ezingakaxazululwa. Ikomkhulu lethu liseParis, futhi siyakhula eSan Francisco. Sisebenza ngesivinini, siphikisana ngamaphrothokholi, futhi sakha izinto ezisebenzayo.
about.officesLead: Ikomkhulu lethu lisenhliziyweni yaseParis, futhi sinezikhungo e-US nase-Asia ukuze sisekele amakhasimende noma kuphi lapho asebenza khona.
about.stackLine: Sibhala ikhodi nge-Rust, nge-C nange-assembly — kanye no-Go kancane.

sdk.lead: I-SDK efanayo inika amandla amarobhothi okuhlinza, amadeskithophu akude, amaqoqo amadroni, izibuko ze-XR nezinhlelo zesiphequluli.
sdk.k1d: Inelayisensi ye-AGPL. Hlola ikhodi, uyiqonde, uyithuthukise.
sdk.k3d: Imitapo yolwazi yazo zonke izinkundla ezisekelwayo. Indlela eyodwa yokuhlanganisa.
sdk.licOpenD: Isetshenziswa mahhala. Izixazululo ezihlanganisa i-Kyber nazo kumele zishicilelwe ngaphansi kwe-AGPL. Ukusakaza kuphela. Usizo lomphakathi.
sdk.licComD: Usizo oluzinikele, usizo lokuhlanganisa, ukufinyelela ezicini ezifana ne-KyHub (iphothali yethu yokuphatha), ikhodi yomthombo eyabelwana ngayo ngaphandle kwamalungelo okusabalalisa.
sdk.matLead: Kuqonde ngqo ku-README yephrojekthi nasemanothini okukhishwa.
sdk.matNotes: Iseva ye-Windows: i-NVENC, kanye ne-QSV ne-AMF ezisesigabeni sokuhlolwa. I-Linux ihlolwe enguqulweni ezinzile ye-Debian (X11); i-VAAPI isesigabeni sokuhlolwa. Iklayenti lesiphequluli: lisebenza ngokugcwele ku-Chromium, lisesigabeni sokuhlolwa ku-Firefox, lisebenza ngokwengxenye ku-WebKit. Umsingathi we-macOS useyi-alpha kusukela ku-0.28 (Apple Silicon).
sdk.bindD: Umongo wakhiwe nge-Rust. I-C ngokusebenzisa i-cbindgen, i-JavaScript ngokusebenzisa i-wasm-bindgen. I-Swift ne-Kotlin kuyeza maduze.
sdk.r28a: I-macOS manje ingaba ngumsingathi (alpha): ukuthwebula nge-ScreenCaptureKit, ukufaka amakhodi nge-VideoToolbox.
sdk.r28b: Ukuchofoza okuwela emigqeni emnyama esemaphethelweni esikrini akusadluliselwa kumsingathi.
sdk.r28c: Injini yesibili yokuthwebula nokufaka amakhodi eyakhelwe ngqo ku-FFmpeg, ekhethwa ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
sdk.r28d: Izinhlobo ze-C API manje zinesiqalo esifanayo — ukuqamba kabusha okulula kwabahlanganisi.
sdk.r27a: Amaklayenti amaningi kumsingathi oyedwa: thwebula futhi ufake amakhodi kanye, bese uphindaphinda ukusakaza.
sdk.r27b: Igrafu ebukhoma yokubambezeleka esigabeni ngasinye kuklayenti lewebhu: iseva, inethiwekhi, isiphequluli.
sdk.r27c: Ukungena nge-OIDC esipheqululini — Keycloak, Auth0, Authelia nokunye.
sdk.r26a: I-OIDC kudeskithophu nakuseva, FFmpeg 8.1, ukulungiswa kokufaka amakhodi kwe-AMD ne-VAAPI.
sdk.r25a: I-IPv6, ukuthwebula nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux, ukwakha ama-JWT ku-kyctl.
sdk.r29a: Indlela eyisipele ye-WebSocket: uma inethiwekhi yenkampani ivimba i-QUIC, i-Kyber iyaqhubeka nokuxhuma.
sdk.r29b: Umbala ogcwele we-4:4:4 ngokucaca kwangempela — ideskithophu ye-4K manje isakaza nge-4K.
sdk.r29c: Ukuthwebula nge-GStreamer nokufaka amakhodi ngokushesha, kuvulela indlela i-Raspberry Pi namadivayisi asemaphethelweni.
sdk.r29d: Isisekelo sokuphatha amaqoqo emishini: uphawu lokuphila komsingathi, ukuvuselelwa kwamathokheni ngokuzenzakalelayo nezixhumanisi ze-kyber://.

faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
faq.a1: Sisebenzisa amalayisensi amabili. I-AGPL v3 yomthombo ovulekile isetshenziswa mahhala, kodwa noma yisiphi isixazululo esihlanganisa i-Kyber kufanele naso sishicilelwe ngaphansi kwe-AGPL; ihlanganisa ukusakaza nosizo lomphakathi. Ilayisensi yezohwebo yengeza usizo oluzinikele, usizo ekuhlanganiseni, izici ezithile ezifana ne-KyHub, iphothali yethu yokuphatha, kanye nekhodi yomthombo eyabelwana ngayo ngaphandle kwamalungelo okusabalalisa.
faq.a2: Yebo. Landela imihlahlandlela yokufaka ku-GitLab yethu: gitlab.com/kyber/kyber.
faq.a3: Ngelayisensi ye-AGPL v3 uthola usizo lomphakathi ku-r/kyber. Ukuze uthole usizo oluzinikele, thola ilayisensi yezohwebo bese uxhumana nethimba lethu lokuthengisa.
faq.a4: Amahhovisi ethu amakhulu aseParis, futhi sinamahhovisi eSan Francisco naseSingapore ukuze sisekele amakhasimende ethu.
faq.a5: Umkhiqizo omkhulu we-Kyber ukhishwe ngaphansi kwe-AGPL v3. Wakhelwe phezu kwemitapo ye-VLC ne-FFmpeg, futhi sinikela kakhulu kukho kokubili. Sizisingathela ngokwethu amathuluzi omthombo ovulekile noma nini lapho kungenzeka khona, futhi sibuyisela umnikelo.

simple.title: I-Kyber, ngamagama alula
simple.whatD: I-Kyber yenza abantu bakwazi ukulawula imishini besekude — amarobhothi, amadroni, izimoto noma amakhompyutha — cishe ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Okwenzayo kufika cishe ngezingxenye eziyi-8 kweziyinkulungwane zomzuzwana.
simple.whoD: Ithimba elingemuva kwe-VLC, isidlali samavidiyo samahhala esisetshenziswa ngamakhulu ezigidi zabantu. Le nkampani izinze eParis.
simple.u1: Ukusebenza kukhompyutha ekude sengathi iphambi kwakho
simple.u3: Ukusiza izimoto ezizishayelayo uma zidinga umuntu
simple.whatD2: Kusebenza njengekholi yevidiyo ebukhoma nomshini: ubona isikrini sawo noma ikhamera yawo, futhi imawusi, ikhibhodi noma induku yakho yokulawula kufinyelela kuwo ngaso leso sikhathi.
simple.whyD: Uma uqondisa irobhothi noma imoto usekude, umzuzwana ngamunye ubalulekile. Ikholi yevidiyo evamile ingabambezeleka kuze kufike esihlanwini somzuzwana — okwanele ukuthi uphuthelwe ijika. I-Kyber yakhelwe ukushesha kangangokuthi amehlo nezandla zakho ngeke kubone ukubambezeleka.
simple.h2: Vula i-Kyber kukhompyutha yakho, kusiphequluli noma kuhedisethi.
simple.h3: Xhuma. Isithombe, umsindo nezilawuli kuhamba ndawonye ngoxhumano olulodwa olubethelwe — ngokushesha nangasese.
simple.freeD: Yebo. Ikhodi ingumthombo ovulekile futhi isetshenziswa mahhala. Izinkampani ezidinga ukuyisebenzisa ngasese, ukwesekwa noma izici ezenzelwe zona zingathola ilayisensi yezohwebo.
simple.audioErr: Umsindo awukwazanga ukulayishwa. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.

sdkm.ctaSub: Imiyalo yokukopisha nokunamathisela yazo zonke izinkundla
sdkm.title: Faka, wakhe futhi uqalise i-Kyber
sdkm.lead: Khetha inkundla yakho. Umugqa ngamunye unenkinobho yawo yokukopisha — noma kopisha yonke ibhulokhi.
sdkm.dStart: Kopisha inqolobane eyinhloko: isingeniso, imibhalo nemephu yazo zonke izingxenye ze-Kyber.
sdkm.dLinux: Yakha iklayenti ledeskithophu nomsingathi kusuka kukhodi yomthombo. Kuhlolwe ku-Debian Bookworm naku-Ubuntu 24.04.
sdkm.dMac: Yakha iklayenti le-macOS nomsingathi osesigabeni se-alpha. Kudingeka i-Rust namathuluzi omugqa womyalo we-Xcode.
sdkm.dWin: Indlela esheshayo kakhulu yisifaki se-Windows esisayiniwe: iklayenti, umsingathi neklayenti lewebhu ephaketheni elilodwa. Ukwakha kusuka kukhodi yomthombo kwenziwa ku-Linux kuhloselwe i-Windows.
sdkm.dRun: Qalisa umsingathi emshinini ofuna ukuwulawula, bese uxhuma usebenzisa iklayenti.
sdkm.note: Imiyalo ithathwe ku-README esemthethweni ye-kyber-desktop. Bheka umhlahlandlela ukuze uthole izimfuneko zakamuva.

car.lead: Ukulawula imishini ngesikhathi sangempela kungenye yezinkinga zekhompyutha ezingakaxazululwa. Singabantu abangu-26 abavela emphakathini we-VLC ne-FFmpeg, futhi sakha inguqulo evulekile wonke umuntu angayisebenzisa.
car.missionD: Kumamilisekhondi angu-200 ubuka okwenzekile. Kumamilisekhondi angu-8 ulawula okwenzeka manje. Siyalivala lelo gebe — kodokotela abahlinzayo, kubaqhubi bemishini, kubashayeli bamadrowni nakuma-ejenti obuhlakani bokwenziwa — futhi sishicilela ikhodi ukuze noma ubani akhe phezu kwayo.
car.legacyD: Ithimba lethu elisungulayo lakha i-VLC, isidlali esifakwe kumadivayisi ayizigidigidi, futhi laba negalelo ku-FFmpeg, injini esekela iningi lamavidiyo ku-inthanethi. I-Kyber ithatha izifundo zeminyaka engamashumi amabili ezizuzwe kanzima mayelana namawashi, ama-codec namanethiwekhi — iziqondise emishinini.
